title: Toyota 2.4 (2AZ-FE): oil consumption and head bolt thread pull
body: Oil consumption from rings on 2006-2011 vehicles; Toyota ran a warranty enhancement on many of them (piston/ring replacement). Separately, the head bolt threads in the aluminum block can pull, causing a coolant leak/head gasket symptoms. Repair is thread inserts in the block, not a new block.
